Our work · Women & Children Charity in Lagos

This is how we show up.

Our work as an NGO is centred on two complementary initiatives: Christmas in the Street, our flagship annual outreach, and Project 1,000 Smiles, our emerging year-round commitment to creating lasting impact for children, women and communities.

Edition 4 · 19 December 2026

Christmas in the Street

An annual Christmas charity outreach in Lagos, bringing Christmas joy to children, free basic health screenings to adults and essential food supplies to widows, market women and mothers. Three editions down, with more smiles to create every December.

Explore Christmas in the Street 2026
ComingSoon

Project 1,000 Smiles

Project 1,000 Smiles carries the spirit of our annual Christmas outreach into every month, so children, women, and communities have someone showing up all year.

About Project 1,000 Smiles

Where we make a difference

Four focus areas. Two programmes.

  • Child Welfare

    Creating safer, brighter futures for children.

  • Women Empowerment

    Supporting mothers and women to build stronger households and communities.

  • Youth Development

    Creating pathways for young people to learn, grow and pursue opportunities.

  • Community Outreach

    Responding to practical needs while building stronger community relationships.

Be part of Edition 4 or Project 1,000 Smiles from day one.
